requirements.title: Setting the webhook secret
requirements.rationale: An operator needs a secret and an ingress URL to enter into the forge's webhook settings, and the secret must never be shown again.

criteria.condition: an authorized caller sends PUT /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/forge/webhook for an active workspace with no body, an empty object {} or {"secret": null}
criteria.action: generate 32 bytes from crypto/rand, hex-encode them to a 64-character secret, store it as the workspace-scope secret FORGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET and return it once
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with body {"configured": true, "url": <ingress URL or null>, "secret": <64 lowercase hex characters>}

setup: an active workspace widgets owned by the caller
a real secrets store on an in-memory SQLite database
external_url is https://hub.example.com
check.pseudocode: for body in [none, '{}', '{"secret":null}']: r = put(body); assert r.status==200; assert re.match('^[0-9a-f]{64}$', r.json.secret); assert store.Get('workspace','widgets','FORGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET') == r.json.secret

criteria.condition: an authorized caller sends PUT …/forge/webhook for an active workspace with {"secret": s} where s is 16 to 255 characters, each in the ASCII range '!' (0x21) to '~' (0x7E)
criteria.action: store s as the workspace-scope secret FORGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with body {"configured": true, "url": <ingress URL or null>} and no secret key

setup: an active workspace widgets owned by the caller
check.pseudocode: for s in [rand(16), rand(40), rand(255)]: r = put({'secret': s}); assert r.status==200; assert 'secret' not in r.json; assert store.Get(...) == s

criteria.condition: the PUT body is not a JSON object, or secret is not a string or null, or a supplied secret is shorter than 16 or longer than 255 characters or contains a character outside '!' to '~'
criteria.action: reject the request without storing anything and without repeating the supplied value in the message
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 via apikit.WriteAPIError whose message names secret and the violated rule; the stored secret is unchanged

setup: an active workspace widgets that already has the secret 'existing-secret-value'
check.pseudocode: for body in invalid: r = put(body); assert r.status==400; assert 'secret' in r.msg; assert supplied not in r.msg; assert store.Get(...)=='existing-secret-value'

criteria.condition: a PUT …/forge/webhook request fails a check, evaluated in the order: no credential, PAT without forge:write, wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace failure, workspace status not active
criteria.action: stop at the first failing check without reading the body or touching the secrets store
criteria.contract: HTTP 401; HTTP 403 with a message naming forge:write; HTTP 404 for a missing or not-owned workspace; HTTP 400 "workspace is not active"

setup: workspace widgets owned by user A and active
workspace old owned by user A and archived
a secrets store wrapper that records calls
check.pseudocode: assert put(noauth).status==401; r=put(pat_read_only); assert r.status==403 and 'forge:write' in r.msg; assert put(userB).status==404; r=put(archived); assert r.status==400 and r.msg=='workspace is not active'; assert store.calls==0

criteria.condition: a valid PUT is received and FORGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET already exists in the workspace scope, or CreateSecrets returns *secrets.ConflictError because a concurrent request created it
criteria.action: update the existing secret with UpdateSecret, retrying the update at most once after a ConflictError
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 as for a fresh secret; exactly one FORGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET entry exists in the workspace scope

setup: a workspace whose scope already has FORGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=old
a second workspace where CreateSecrets returns *ConflictError once because another request created the key
check.pseudocode: put({'secret': new}); assert len(store.List('workspace', slug) where key=='FORGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET')==1; assert store.Get(...)==new

criteria.condition: the secrets store rejects the create because the workspace scope already holds 100 entries, or any other secrets store call fails
criteria.action: answer with an error and emit no audit event
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 carrying the store's message for a full scope; HTTP 500 for any other store failure

setup: a workspace whose scope holds 100 secrets
a store stub whose UpdateSecret fails with a generic error
a recording emitter
check.pseudocode: r=put(full); assert r.status==400 and 'maximum of 100 entries' in r.msg; r=put(broken); assert r.status==500; assert emitter.events==[]

criteria.action: build the ingress URL as server.external_url with any trailing '/' removed followed by /hooks/forge/<slug>, report it as null when external_url is unset, and store the secret in both cases
criteria.contract: url field equals e.g. https://hub.example.com/hooks/forge/widgets for external_url https://hub.example.com/; null when unset

setup: external_url configured as https://hub.example.com/ in one run and empty in another
check.pseudocode: assert put().json.url=='https://hub.example.com/hooks/forge/widgets'; cfg.ExternalURL=''; r=put(); assert r.json.url is None; assert store.Get(...) != ''

criteria.condition: a PUT …/forge/webhook stores the secret
criteria.action: emit hub.forge.webhook.set through forge.Config.Audit with workspace set to the slug and metadata {generated: bool}, never including the secret value
criteria.contract: one hub.forge.webhook.set audit event whose metadata contains only generated

setup: a recording emitter in forge.Config.Audit
check.pseudocode: assert events[0].Metadata=={'generated':True}; assert events[1].Metadata=={'generated':False}

requirements.title: Removing the secret and reporting webhook state
requirements.rationale: Turning ingress off must always be possible, and operators need to see whether a webhook is configured without ever seeing the secret.

criteria.condition: an authorized caller sends DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/forge/webhook, whatever the workspace status
criteria.action: delete FORGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET from the workspace scope when present and emit hub.forge.webhook.unset with metadata {existed: bool}
criteria.contract: HTTP 204 whether or not the secret existed; existed is false when DeleteSecret returned *secrets.NotFoundError

setup: an active workspace with the secret set
an archived workspace with the secret set
an active workspace without the secret
a recording emitter
check.pseudocode: for ws in three: assert delete(ws).status==204; assert [e.Metadata['existed'] for e in events]==[True,True,False]

criteria.condition: a DELETE …/forge/webhook request has no credential, is a PAT without forge:write, or fails wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace
criteria.action: stop at the first failing check without touching the secrets store
criteria.contract: HTTP 401, HTTP 403 naming forge:write, or HTTP 404 respectively; a non-NotFound store failure answers HTTP 500

setup: a secrets store wrapper that records calls and can fail DeleteSecret with a generic error
check.pseudocode: assert delete(noauth).status==401; ...; assert delete(broken).status==500

criteria.condition: a delivery arrives for a workspace whose secret was removed by DELETE …/forge/webhook
criteria.action: refuse the delivery and leave the workspace's existing delivery-log rows in place until they are pruned
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 identical to the unknown-slug answer; previously recorded rows are still returned by GET …/forge/deliveries

setup: workspace widgets with a secret and one recorded delivery row
ingress and API routes registered on one Echo instance with a real SQLite database
check.pseudocode: delete(); r=post_signed(); assert r.status==404 and r.body==post('/hooks/forge/nosuch').body; assert len(get_deliveries())==1

criteria.condition: an authorized caller sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/forge
criteria.action: add a webhook block to the response defined by 30_forge_client_reads without sending any request to the forge
criteria.contract: response contains "webhook": {"configured": bool, "url": <ingress URL or null>, "last_delivery_at": <UTC timestamp or null>}

setup: workspace A with a secret and delivery rows received_at 09:00 (ignored) and 09:12 (malformed)
workspace B with no secret and no rows
a forge transport that fails the test on any request
check.pseudocode: a=get('A'); assert a.webhook=={'configured':True,'url':url,'last_delivery_at':'…09:12:00Z'}; b=get('B'); assert b.webhook.configured==False and b.webhook.last_delivery_at is None

criteria.action: set configured to true exactly when the workspace-scope FORGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET exists, and set last_delivery_at to the latest received_at among the workspace's delivery-log rows of any outcome, or null when there are none
criteria.contract: configured false and last_delivery_at null for a workspace with no secret and no rows

criteria.condition: reading the secrets store or the delivery log fails while building GET …/forge
criteria.action: answer with an error instead of a partial webhook block
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 via apikit.WriteAPIError

setup: one run with a secrets store that fails with a generic error
one run with the forge_deliveries table dropped
check.pseudocode: assert get().status==500 and 'webhook' not in get().json

criteria.action: for any request other than the PUT …/forge/webhook that generated the value, never include the webhook secret value in a response body, a log line, audit event metadata or a delivery-log row
criteria.contract: the secret string does not occur in GET …/forge, GET …/forge/deliveries, DELETE responses, captured logs, or hub_audit_events metadata

setup: captured slog output, a real audit store and a real delivery log
check.pseudocode: for s in gen_secrets(): run_all(s); for sink in [responses_except_put, logs, audit_metadata, delivery_rows]: assert s not in str(sink)

requirements.title: Ingress endpoint and delivery verification
requirements.rationale: The ingress is public, so the signature is the only proof that a delivery came from the forge configured with the workspace secret.

criteria.action: serve POST /hooks/forge/:slug on the Echo root beside /git/..., outside the API group and apikit's bearer authentication, without taking a workspace lock or contacting the forge
criteria.contract: a request without an Authorization header reaches the handler

setup: an Echo instance with the API group protected by bearer authentication and the ingress mounted on the root, no lock manager supplied
a forge transport that fails on any request
check.pseudocode: assert post_signed(no_auth).status==202; assert get('/api/v1/workspaces/widgets/forge').status==401

criteria.condition: the slug names no workspace, or the workspace has no workspace-scope FORGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET (org-scoped and user-scoped values are never read)
criteria.action: refuse the delivery before reading the body, writing no row and emitting no event; a database or secrets-store failure during the lookup answers 500 instead
criteria.contract: HTTP 404 with byte-identical bodies for the unknown-slug and no-secret cases; HTTP 500 on lookup failure

setup: workspace nosecret without a secret but with an org-scoped and a user-scoped FORGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
a body reader that fails the test if read
a variant where the workspaces table is missing
check.pseudocode: a=post('/hooks/forge/nosuch'); b=post('/hooks/forge/nosecret'); assert a.status==404 and a.body==b.body; assert post(dbfail).status==500

criteria.condition: a delivery carries X-Hub-Signature-256
criteria.action: treat it as GitHub and accept it only when the header is 'sha256=' followed by 64 hex digits that equal the HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body under the secret, compared with hmac.Equal
criteria.contract: verification passes only for the exact signature of the received bytes

setup: workspace widgets with secret S and a valid issues labeled body
check.pseudocode: assert post(sig='sha256='+hmac(S,body)).status==202; for bad in variants: assert post(sig=bad).status==401

criteria.condition: a delivery carries X-Gitlab-Token and no X-Hub-Signature-256
criteria.action: treat it as GitLab and compare the token with the secret using crypto/subtle constant-time comparison before reading the body
criteria.contract: verification passes only when the token equals the secret

setup: workspace widgets with secret S
a body reader that records whether it was read
check.pseudocode: r=post(token='x', body=tracking); assert r.status==401 and not body.read; assert post(token=S).status==202

criteria.condition: a delivery has neither X-Hub-Signature-256 nor X-Gitlab-Token, or its signature is malformed or wrong, or its token is wrong
criteria.action: refuse it, write no delivery-log row, emit no event, and log at warn level with only the slug and the scheme, never a header value or the body
criteria.contract: HTTP 401 with message "delivery signature missing or invalid" in every case; forge_deliveries and hub_audit_events row counts unchanged

setup: workspace widgets with a secret
captured slog output
empty forge_deliveries and hub_audit_events
check.pseudocode: for req in bad: r=post(req); assert r.status==401 and r.msg=='delivery signature missing or invalid'; assert count(deliveries)==0; assert header_value not in logs and body not in logs

criteria.condition: the delivery body exceeds 1 MiB (1048576 bytes) or apikit's max_body_size
criteria.action: refuse it, write no row and emit no event
criteria.contract: HTTP 413; the handler's own 413 is written with apikit.WriteAPIErrorWithType and error_type body_too_large

setup: workspace widgets with a secret
one Echo instance with max_body_size raised above 1 MiB and one with the 1MB default
check.pseudocode: r=post_signed(size=1<<20+1); assert r.status==413 and r.error_type=='body_too_large'; assert count(rows)==0

criteria.action: read the secret with GetSecretValue("workspace", slug, "FORGE_WEBHOOK_SECRET") on every delivery without caching it, so a rotated secret applies from the next delivery
criteria.contract: after rotation, a delivery signed with the old secret answers 401 and one signed with the new secret is accepted

setup: workspace widgets with secret OLD accepted once
a real secrets store
check.pseudocode: put({'secret':NEW}); assert post(sign(OLD, body, id='d2')).status==401; assert post(sign(NEW, body, id='d3')).status==202

criteria.condition: the workspace status is archived and its secret exists
criteria.action: verify, record and relay deliveries exactly as for an active workspace
criteria.contract: HTTP 202 with the same outcome an active workspace would get

setup: an archived workspace widgets with a secret and origin repo acme/widgets
a recording emitter
check.pseudocode: r=post_signed(); assert r.status==202 and r.json.outcome=='relayed'; assert len(emitter.events)==1

requirements.title: Delivery identity, deduplication and the delivery log
requirements.rationale: Forges retry deliveries, so each delivery must be recorded and relayed at most once, atomically, in the transactional store.

criteria.action: create the SQLite table forge_deliveries (workspace_slug, delivery_id, forge, event, action, target, outcome, relayed, received_at) with primary key (workspace_slug, delivery_id) and an index on (workspace_slug, received_at), idempotently and without altering existing rows
criteria.contract: forge.InitSchema(db) returns nil on repeated calls and row counts are unchanged

setup: an empty SQLite database
check.pseudocode: assert InitSchema(db)==nil; insert(row); assert InitSchema(db)==nil; assert count==1; assert pragma_table_info columns == expected

criteria.condition: a delivery passes verification
criteria.action: take the delivery id from X-GitHub-Delivery (GitHub) or from Idempotency-Key, else X-Gitlab-Event-UUID (GitLab), take the event name from X-GitHub-Event or X-Gitlab-Event, and store the event name cut to 64 bytes
criteria.contract: the recorded row's delivery_id and event match these headers

setup: workspace widgets with a secret
an event name longer than 64 bytes in one GitHub case
check.pseudocode: assert row.delivery_id=='gh-1'; assert json.loads(row.relayed)==['hub.forge.issue.labeled']; assert len(row.event.encode())<=64

criteria.condition: a verified delivery lacks the delivery id or the event name, or its delivery id is longer than 255 characters or contains a character outside printable ASCII
criteria.action: refuse it without writing a row or emitting an event
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 via apikit.WriteAPIError; forge_deliveries row count unchanged

setup: workspace widgets with a secret
check.pseudocode: for req in bad: assert post(req).status==400; assert count(rows)==0; assert post(id='a'*255).status==202

criteria.condition: a verified delivery with a new (workspace_slug, delivery_id) has been reduced
criteria.action: insert one row with forge github or gitlab, the event, the payload action or "", target origin/upstream/NULL, the outcome, relayed as a JSON array of the hub event types to be emitted, and received_at from apikit.NowUTC(), using INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
criteria.contract: exactly one forge_deliveries row for the delivery

criteria.condition: the insert affects no row because (workspace_slug, delivery_id) is already recorded
criteria.action: treat the delivery as a duplicate and emit nothing
criteria.contract: HTTP 202 with body {"outcome":"duplicate"}; no event and no new row

setup: workspace widgets with a secret and a recording emitter
one prior accepted delivery gh-1
check.pseudocode: post(); r=post(); assert r.json=={'outcome':'duplicate'}; assert count(rows)==1; assert len(emitter.events)==1

criteria.condition: the delivery-log insert fails
criteria.action: emit nothing so that a redelivery is processed in full
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 via apikit.WriteAPIError; no hub.forge.* event

setup: workspace widgets with a secret and a recording emitter
forge_deliveries dropped so the insert fails
check.pseudocode: drop(); assert post().status==500; assert emitter.events==[]; InitSchema(db); assert post().json.outcome=='relayed'

criteria.action: for any number N >= 1 of deliveries with the same workspace and delivery id, including concurrent ones, record exactly one row and relay its events exactly once, answering every other copy with outcome duplicate
criteria.contract: one row, one set of events, N-1 duplicate answers

setup: workspace widgets with a secret and a recording emitter
check.pseudocode: for n in range(1,21): res = parallel(post, n); assert count(rows)==1; assert counter(res.outcome)=={'relayed':1,'duplicate':n-1}; assert len(emitter.events)==1

requirements.title: Payload parsing, repository binding and non-relayed outcomes
requirements.rationale: A delivery about another repository must never be relayed as this workspace's, or a consumer would act on the wrong issue.

criteria.condition: a verified delivery body is not a JSON object, or a field the relayed kind needs is missing
criteria.action: record the row with outcome malformed and emit nothing
criteria.contract: HTTP 400; one forge_deliveries row with outcome malformed

setup: workspace widgets with a secret and a recording emitter
check.pseudocode: for b in bad: assert post(b).status==400; assert [r.outcome for r in rows]==['malformed']*4; assert emitter.events==[]

criteria.condition: a verified delivery's event and action are not in the GitHub or GitLab mapping (for example GitHub ping, pull_request.labeled, issue_comment.edited, GitLab Confidential Issue Hook, Confidential Note Hook, notes on commits or snippets)
criteria.action: record the row with outcome ignored and emit nothing
criteria.contract: HTTP 202 with body {"outcome":"ignored"}

setup: workspace widgets with a secret and a recording emitter
check.pseudocode: for d in cases: assert post(d).json=={'outcome':'ignored'}; assert emitter.events==[]

criteria.condition: a delivery of a relayed kind names a repository (GitHub repository.full_name, GitLab project.path_with_namespace) equal, ignoring case, to the origin owner path and name parsed from git_url
criteria.action: bind the delivery to target origin
criteria.contract: row target and event metadata target are origin

setup: workspace git_url https://forge.example.com/Acme/Widgets.git
a nested GitLab namespace variant group/sub/widgets
check.pseudocode: assert row.target=='origin'; assert event.Metadata['target']=='origin'

criteria.condition: a delivery of a relayed kind names a repository that matches only the upstream repository parsed from upstream_url and the workspace_mode is carry_patch and upstream_url is set
criteria.action: bind the delivery to target upstream
criteria.contract: row target and event metadata target are upstream

setup: carry_patch workspace with git_url …/acme/widgets and upstream_url …/upstream/widgets
check.pseudocode: post(repo='upstream/widgets'); assert row.target=='upstream' and event.Metadata['target']=='upstream'

criteria.condition: a delivery of a relayed kind names a repository matching neither origin nor (on a carry_patch workspace) upstream, or the workspace remote cannot be parsed
criteria.action: record the row with outcome repository_mismatch and target NULL, and emit nothing
criteria.contract: HTTP 202 with body {"outcome":"repository_mismatch"}; no hub.forge.* event

setup: a workspace with origin acme/widgets
a standard workspace that has an upstream_url
a carry_patch workspace without upstream_url
a workspace whose git_url cannot be parsed
check.pseudocode: for ws in cases: r=post(ws); assert r.json.outcome=='repository_mismatch'; assert row.target is None; assert emitter.events==[]

requirements.title: GitHub delivery mapping
requirements.rationale: Consumers receive one forge-neutral event vocabulary regardless of the forge.

criteria.condition: a bound GitHub issues delivery has action opened, edited, closed, reopened, labeled or unlabeled
criteria.action: produce hub.forge.issue.opened, .edited, .closed, .reopened, .labeled or .unlabeled respectively
criteria.contract: one event of that type; outcome relayed

setup: a bound workspace and a recording emitter
check.pseudocode: for a in actions: post(issues, a); assert [e.EventType for e in emitter.events]==['hub.forge.issue.'+a for a in actions]

criteria.condition: a bound GitHub issue_comment delivery has action created
criteria.action: produce hub.forge.comment.created with pull_request true when issue.pull_request is present and false otherwise
criteria.contract: one hub.forge.comment.created event

setup: a bound workspace and a recording emitter
check.pseudocode: assert [e.Metadata['pull_request'] for e in events]==[True,False]

criteria.condition: a bound GitHub pull_request delivery has action opened, reopened, synchronize or closed
criteria.action: produce hub.forge.pull_request.opened, .reopened or .synchronize, and for closed produce .merged when pull_request.merged is true and .closed otherwise
criteria.contract: one pull_request event; a merged pull request never yields .closed

setup: a bound workspace and a recording emitter
check.pseudocode: assert types==['…opened','…reopened','…synchronize','…merged','…closed']

criteria.condition: a bound GitHub push delivery is received
criteria.action: produce hub.forge.push
criteria.contract: one hub.forge.push event

setup: a bound workspace and a recording emitter
check.pseudocode: assert [e.EventType for e in events]==['hub.forge.push']

requirements.title: GitLab delivery mapping
requirements.rationale: GitLab reports label and edit changes inside a single update action, which must map to the same events GitHub produces.

criteria.condition: a bound GitLab Issue Hook has object_attributes.action open, close or reopen
criteria.action: produce hub.forge.issue.opened, .closed or .reopened respectively
criteria.contract: one event of that type

setup: a bound workspace and a recording emitter
check.pseudocode: assert types==['hub.forge.issue.opened','hub.forge.issue.closed','hub.forge.issue.reopened']

criteria.condition: a bound GitLab Issue Hook has action update
criteria.action: produce, in this order, hub.forge.issue.edited when changes has title or description, then one .unlabeled per label in changes.labels.previous and not in current, then one .labeled per label in current and not in previous, each group sorted by label name
criteria.contract: events emitted in that order; a change adding A and removing B yields .unlabeled(B) then .labeled(A)

setup: a bound workspace and a recording emitter
check.pseudocode: assert types==['edited','unlabeled','unlabeled','labeled','labeled']; assert [e.Metadata['label'] for e in events[1:]]==['b','z','a','y']

criteria.condition: a bound GitLab Issue Hook update has no title, description or label change
criteria.action: produce no event
criteria.contract: HTTP 202 with body {"outcome":"ignored"}

setup: a bound workspace and a recording emitter
check.pseudocode: assert post(update_no_change).json.outcome=='ignored'; assert emitter.events==[]

criteria.condition: a bound GitLab Note Hook has noteable_type Issue or MergeRequest and an absent or create action
criteria.action: produce hub.forge.comment.created with number from issue.iid or merge_request.iid and pull_request true for a merge request
criteria.contract: one hub.forge.comment.created event

setup: a bound workspace and a recording emitter
check.pseudocode: assert [(e.Metadata['number'],e.Metadata['pull_request']) for e in events]==[(7,False),(9,True)]

criteria.condition: a bound GitLab Merge Request Hook has action open, close, reopen, merge, or update
criteria.action: produce hub.forge.pull_request.opened, .closed, .reopened or .merged respectively, produce .synchronize for an update with oldrev present, and produce nothing (outcome ignored) for an update without oldrev
criteria.contract: one pull_request event, or outcome ignored

setup: a bound workspace and a recording emitter
check.pseudocode: assert types==['opened','closed','reopened','merged','synchronize']; assert last.json.outcome=='ignored'

criteria.condition: a bound GitLab Push Hook or Tag Push Hook is received
criteria.action: produce hub.forge.push
criteria.contract: one hub.forge.push event

setup: a bound workspace and a recording emitter
check.pseudocode: assert [e.EventType for e in events]==['hub.forge.push']*2

requirements.title: Event contents and relay
requirements.rationale: Events must carry enough reduced facts for a consumer to act while never storing the payload, and a slow audit store must not hold the forge's connection open.

criteria.action: set on every relayed HubEvent Workspace to the slug, ActorType to forge, ActorID to "", ResourceType to issue, comment, pull_request or repository (push), ResourceID to the decimal number (GitLab iid) or the ref for a push, and Action to the last segment of the event type
criteria.contract: HubEvent fields as listed

setup: a bound workspace widgets and a recording emitter
check.pseudocode: assert set(e.Metadata)==base | extra[kind]; assert e.ActorType=='forge' and e.ActorID==''; assert e.Action==e.EventType.split('.')[-1]

criteria.action: put forge, target, delivery_id and actor (forge login, "" when absent) in every event's metadata, adding number/title/url/labels for issue opened/edited/closed/reopened, number/label/labels/url for issue labeled/unlabeled, number/comment_url/pull_request for comments, number/url/head/base/merged for pull requests, and ref/before/after for pushes, and no other payload field
criteria.contract: metadata keys are exactly the listed set for the kind

criteria.action: for any payload, cut title to at most 256 bytes on a UTF-8 boundary and remove userinfo from every URL taken from the payload
criteria.contract: metadata title is valid UTF-8 of at most 256 bytes; no metadata URL contains user:password@

setup: a bound workspace and a recording emitter
check.pseudocode: for title,url in gen(): post(issue_opened(title,url)); t=e.Metadata['title']; assert len(t.encode())<=256 and valid_utf8(t) and title.startswith(t); assert '@' not in userinfo(e.Metadata['url'])

criteria.action: declare each delivery event type (hub.forge.issue.opened/edited/closed/reopened/labeled/unlabeled, hub.forge.comment.created, hub.forge.pull_request.opened/closed/merged/reopened/synchronize, hub.forge.push) and hub.forge.webhook.set/unset as an exported constant with a doc comment in internal/audit/types.go
criteria.contract: each constant's value equals its event type string

setup: the internal/audit package
check.pseudocode: assert audit.EventForgeIssueOpened=='hub.forge.issue.opened'; …; assert doc_comment(const) != ''

criteria.condition: a verified delivery is recorded with outcome relayed, ignored or repository_mismatch
criteria.action: write and flush the answer before emitting any event, never storing or logging the payload
criteria.contract: HTTP 202 with body {"outcome": "relayed" | "ignored" | "repository_mismatch"}; relayed means at least one event is handed to the emitter

setup: an emitter whose Emit blocks until the test releases it
workspace widgets with a secret
check.pseudocode: resp = http.post(); assert resp.status==202 and resp.json.outcome=='relayed'; assert emitter.blocked; release(); assert emitter.count==1

criteria.condition: the 202 answer for a relayed delivery has been flushed
criteria.action: emit the produced events in order through forge.Config.Audit with context.WithoutCancel, so the broadcast emitter stores them in hub_audit_events and puts them on the SSE stream
criteria.contract: events visible on GET /api/v1/events?workspace=<slug> and GET /api/v1/audit?workspace=<slug> in production order

setup: a real DuckDB audit store, SSE manager and broadcast emitter
audit query routes registered, a user owning workspace widgets, and an open GET /api/v1/events?workspace=widgets stream
check.pseudocode: post(update); assert sse.read_types()==['hub.forge.issue.unlabeled','hub.forge.issue.labeled']; assert [e.event_type for e in get_audit()]==same

criteria.condition: forge.Config.Audit.Emit returns an error
criteria.action: log the error with slog and continue emitting the remaining events

requirements.title: Delivery log API and retention
requirements.rationale: Operators debug webhook setup from the log, and a pruner that is never scheduled is a known trap in this repository.

criteria.condition: an authorized caller sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/forge/deliveries, whatever the workspace status
criteria.action: return the workspace's delivery-log rows newest first by received_at, filtered by since (RFC 3339, inclusive) when given, limited to limit rows (1 to 100, default 30)
criteria.contract: HTTP 200 with a bare JSON array ([] when empty) of {delivery_id, forge, event, action, target, outcome, relayed, received_at}

setup: an archived workspace with 40 rows with distinct received_at values
an empty workspace
check.pseudocode: assert len(get().json)==30; assert get(since=t10).json[-1].received_at==t10; assert get_empty().json==[]

criteria.condition: since is not an RFC 3339 timestamp, or limit is not an integer from 1 to 100
criteria.action: reject the request
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 whose message names since or limit

setup: an active workspace
check.pseudocode: for q in bad: r=get(q); assert r.status==400 and name in r.msg

criteria.condition: a GET …/forge/deliveries request has no credential, is a PAT holding neither forge:read nor forge:write, or fails wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace
criteria.action: stop at the first failing check
criteria.contract: HTTP 401, HTTP 403 naming forge:read, or HTTP 404 respectively

setup: workspaces owned by users A and B
check.pseudocode: assert get(noauth).status==401; r=get(pat_other); assert r.status==403 and 'forge:read' in r.msg; assert get(userB).status==404; assert get(pat_read).status==200 and get(pat_write).status==200

a row 1 day old for slug gone that is not in workspaces
